name: society-erp
description: SOCIETY ERP - configurable multi-tenant SaaS for housing societies, RWAs, apartment complexes and townships

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w packages/shared && npm run typecheck -w apps/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w packages/shared && npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w apps/api && npm run test -w apps/web
